column1: # NeQuick-G slant TEC, TECU, from the JRC reference implementation of the Galileo ionospheric
# correction algorithm (NeQuickG JRC 1.0, 2019-12-10, EUPL-1.2), run on these inputs by
# tools/nequick-jrc-oracle and printed with 17 significant digits.
# Inputs: the 108 receiver/satellite/epoch cases of Annex E of "European GNSS (Galileo) Open
# Service. Ionospheric Correction Algorithm for Galileo Single Frequency Users, issue 1.2,
# September 2016" (© European Union, reused with attribution), each repeated for all twelve
# months; then two geometries of Orekit's NeQuickGalileoTest (anti-meridian, zenith).
# icd_table_stec_tecu is the Annex E printed value (2 decimals) for the month it was published
# with (April), "-" elsewhere: tables E.1-E.3 on pp. 49-51 of issue 1.2.
